ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 250 Section ADO is an Honors section for both MCB Honors students and James Scholars. All other interested students should contact Shawna Naidu at shawna@illinois.edu for information and approval. Both lecture and discussion begin on Monday, August 26, 2013. MCB 250 Discussion sections will not meet the week of September 2, 2013. Examinations will be held on Wednesday evenings from 7:00-9:00 pm on September 18, October 16, and November 13, 2013. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment. This course-based tuition is non-refundaable after the 10th day of class.
